census_method: Exact string equality, no normalization. Compare every candidate against gold input and all decoded JSON values/keys plus quoted literals in every existing testdata/releases file. This deliberately conservative literal-evidence universe includes metadata, excluded inputs and historical probes; an exact match is not proof of independent title authority. Each overlap includes the exact evidence file. New count therefore excludes any occurrence in saved source/probe bytes, including moistari. Source snapshots make census reproducible; it is not a full admission audit of old sources.
